images.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Photorealistic illustration of an explicit biblical comparison or event, first-century Roman Judea and Galilee, landscape 3:2, natural materials and daylight, anatomically coherent people with exactly two arms and animals with correct limbs; fully covering modest opaque robes. No modern objects, readable writing, portrait of God the Father, blood, injury or watermark. Bethany, before Passover. Adult Martha carries a bowl to the low dinner table where Jesus and the resurrected adult Lazarus recline among friends. Focus on serving and the living Lazarus, not on an anointing.

rows: Zij spreken Filippus aan: zij willen Jezus zien.

images.alt: Een stem en twee reacties met gecontroleerde tekstgegevens.
